additional_info.subject: ID0445257-DC/Si-D/FR-[RVP/T3170004585]CCS cable replacement - DC1 CRM:00315002932
additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues, please check Router 1 and why it's not connecting to SCB. Please bring a spare router just in case. Also we see error in the DC1 TempSensor, since the charger is not available to check remotely I cannot say which error is happening but I assume it's the temperature sensors out of range. Please measure the resistance to the StateMonitor and see where it drops or if it comes from the cable.
I recommend bringing a spare CCS cable and StateMonitor.
